source: TASK-064 Phase B report and independent reviewer
question: Should Phase B restrict the closed-loop theory target to constant-reference equilibrium regulation, or retain general time-varying tracking?
recommendation: Restrict the first closed-loop theory result to constant-reference equilibrium regulation. Current cost and value-function shift can then use time-invariant V_N and fixed z_s; general tracking remains outside the theorem.
impact: This removes reference-phase terms from the first proof and makes fixed terminal target z_s meaningful; it does not prove plant-state stability or remove terminal/feasibility/detection assumptions.
alternative: Retain general tracking only with V_{N,k}, shifted references, time-indexed terminal targets and additional terminal feasibility analysis.
